_about: Casos reais do historico do Claude Code (~/.claude/history.jsonl), parafraseados e anonimizados. Rotulos feitos por LLM; revisar.
_notes: Todos os segredos, logins e hosts sao ficticios (joao, Xyz!123fake, sk-fake-000, erp.example.com). Casos sinteticos (sem exemplo real proximo): contains_credentials 'Authorization: Bearer' e 'tela de troca de senha'; destructive_intent 'git filter-repo + push --force' e o dump 'por cima' do banco de teste (parafraseado de um pedido de dump para o banco de teste). A classe question e rara no historico (~30 prompts com '?' ou 'como/qual'). Alguns casos se repetem entre perguntas de proposito.

request_kind.instructions: What is the developer asking the coding agent to do?

criteria.fix_bug: correct an error, crash, wrong value or broken behaviour
criteria.new_feature: build or change a screen, report, field, endpoint or behaviour
criteria.plan_spec: write, update or revalidate a specification, plan or PRD before coding
criteria.run_tests: execute tests, validate in the browser or check that something works
criteria.docs_tooling: update documentation, skills, agent config, install or configure tools
criteria.question: ask for an explanation or opinion, no change requested

work_area.instructions: Which area of the system does this request mainly touch?

criteria.database: SQL, tables, columns, queries, indexes, migrations or data fixes
criteria.screen_ui: templates, layout, buttons, forms, charts, CSS or JavaScript in the page
criteria.fiscal_finance: invoices, NF-e, taxes, payments, billing, cash or financial reports
criteria.stock_orders: products, stock, orders, production or logistics
criteria.agent_tooling: Claude skills, AGENTS.md, hooks, MCP, docker or developer tools
criteria.integration: external APIs, e-commerce stores, e-mail sending, webhooks or error monitoring
